asset.label: Okanagan Similkameen Health Region: logo, traced vector
asset.publisher: Okanagan Similkameen Health Region; reproduced in Douglas Gordon Stickney, Royal Roads University thesis, Library and Archives Canada
asset.sourceLocator: Traced from a supplied black-and-white GIF (600 × 490 px) of the logo; the design is the one on the cover of the June 1999 health services plan
asset.dateNote: The 1999 plan dates a sighting of the design; the supplied GIF's own publication is not recorded.
asset.notes: The silhouettes of two adults and a child inside an arc, with OKANAGAN SIMILKAMEEN set around it and HEALTH REGION reversed out of a bar below.
asset.fidelityNote: Traced with Potrace from the supplied GIF, not original artwork: its outlines overlap the GIF's ink 98 percent at the GIF's size, the difference being the image's stair-stepped edges. The lettering is the traced shapes, not a font. The supplied GIF is kept as a download.
